senses.gloss:
(ङ) च्युङ् r. 1st cl. (च्यवते)
1 To go or move.
2 To flow, to drop.
r. 10th cl. (च्यावयति)
1 To laugh.
2 To bear or suffer.

(इर) च्युतिर r. 1st cl. (च्योतति)
To wet thoroughly, to moisten^1 a little, to sprinkle, to drop, to exude.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Fallen, dropped, oozed out, &c.
2 Fallen, from or off.
3 Deviated from, erred, strayed.
4 Broken, disordered.
5 Lost.
E.
च्यु to go, affix क्त.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Deviating from duty.
E.
च्युत, and आचार rite, usage.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Dismissed, (from an office, &c.) deprived of, (as a right.)
E.
च्युत lost, and अधिकार function.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Spent, exhausted, incapable of effort.
E.
च्युत, and उत्साह exertion.

f. (-तिः)
1 Dropping, dripping, oozing.
2 Falling, falling from.
3 Deviating from.
4 The vulva.
5 The anus.
E.
च्यु to fall, &c. affix क्तिन्; also with ङीष्, च्युती; again with the radical vowel protracted च्यूति &c.; and without the semivowel च्युति, &c.

m. (-पः)
The face.
E.
च्यु to laugh, प Uṇādi aff.

r. 10th cl. (च्चोसयति)
1 To laugh.
2 To bear.
3 To loose.
4 To hurt or kill.
